runtime_prerequisites: Linux with an available FUSE device/kernel interface
fusepy installed in the owner process Python environment
the active OneHost owner lease for p0.model_download
a separate owner-private writable local pack directory with at least 3 GiB free
an owner-private writable SHA-receipt directory under /root/nox/state
range_mount.mount_mode: read-only pinned GGUF files; only virtual /maya-ds4 maps to local writable pack-root
range_mount.cache: bounded in-process RAM LRU, default 4 GiB
range_mount.maya_pack: local writable backing directory exposed only as /maya-ds4
range_mount.owner_stop_gate: checked at mount start and every direct-I/O read
range_mount.persistent_disk_fallback: nox-control/deepseek_owner_range_v10.py with its SHA-verified final files and receipts
range_mount.full_sha_for_remote_ranges: full SHA-256 streamed before mount on first use; a small receipt is reused only for the exact source and strong ETag
range_mount.range_reads_after_mount: exact byte range, length, strong ETag and HTTPS are enforced

preflight_resume.scope: six unique GGUF source files; the shared Engram alias adds no duplicate bytes
preflight_resume.checkpoint_granularity: one completed 128 MiB HTTP Range, with a serializable SHA256_CTX cursor
receipt_binding: exact source path, size, pinned SHA-256 and strong ETag
exact live OneHost lease path, request ID and SHA-256 of canonical lease payload
OpenSSL SHA-256 backend/version and context ABI
preflight_resume.receipt_write: atomic mode-0600 per-range progress receipt with fsync; final full-file SHA receipt is atomic no-clobber
preflight_resume.interrupted_file: resume from last durable range cursor only when the pinned source ETag and exact live lease/request/backend match; otherwise HOLD
preflight_resume.failure_policy: physical OWNER_STOP remains present during hash and pack; the exact request-bound PREPARE token allows only the pinned GGUF FUSE reads and isolated writable pack path; no full model shard is spooled to disk
